summary: Kevin A. Vose specializes in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy. He earned his BA from Bates College in 1992 and his MA and PhD (2005) from the University of Virginia, studying under Jeffrey Hopkins and Ngawang Jinpa.

Kevin Buckelew works in Buddhist studies and Sinology. He attended Sarah Lawrence College and pursued doctoral studies under Chün-fang Yü, Bernard Faure, and Zhaohua Yang, along with teachers Yan Ling, Fumiko Nazikian, Courtney Bender, and Chao-heng Liao.
Kexin Zheng works in Indology and religious studies. As attested in 2026, Zheng is a PhD candidate at Leiden University under the doctoral supervision of Peter C. Bisschop.

Khakyab Dorje (1871–1922) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under Jamgön Kongtrul Lodrö Thayé, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, and others, and taught students including Kalu Rinpoche and the 1st Beru Khyentse Rinpoche.
Kham Sum Zilnön Gyepa Dorjé studied under Shenphen Nangwa and Thubten Chökyi Dorje. He later taught Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.

Khammai Dhammasami is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a DPhil at the University of Oxford (~2000–2004). He founded the Oxford Buddha Vihara, served as its abbot, held posts at Oxford, and founded Shan State Buddhist University in 2014.
Khangsar Tenpe Wangchuk (1938–2014) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under traditional teachers Palyul Choktrul Jampal Gyepe Dorje and Akyong Tokden Lodrö Gyatso.
Khantipālo studied under Sangharakshita (~1959–1963), Dhardo Rinpoche, Namkhai Norbu, and Dudjom Rinpoche. He also taught Ayya Khema.
Khenchen Ngawang Khyen Rab Gyatso studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Trulshik Rinpoche.
Khenchen Tashi Özer studied under Jamgön Kongtrul Lodrö Thayé, Patrul Rinpoche, and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo. He taught Pema Wangchok Gyelpo and Khakyab Dorje.

Khenchen Thrangu Rinpoche (1933–2023) worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, studying under Khenpo Gangshar and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje. He founded Thrangu Monastery, Thrangu Tashi Choling, and Thrangu House, serving as abbot at Rumtek, Karma Shri Nalanda, and Gampo Abbey.
Khenchen Tsewang Rigdzin studied under Shenphen Nangwa, Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang, Thubten Chökyi Dorje, and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo.

Khenpo Appey (1927–2010) was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who studied at Dzongsar Shedra and under Khenpo Dragyab Lodrö. He served as director of Sakya College (1972–1985) and held a post at the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology.

Khenpo Dazer worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, studying under Botrul Dongak Tenpai Nyima. He served as a teacher at Dzogchen Monastery and Ngagyur Nyingma Institute, and taught Chökyi Nyima Rinpoche.

Khenpo Gangshar (1925–1980) was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who studied at Shechen Monastery under Shechen Kongtrul and Jamgon Kongtrul II. He served as senior teacher at Shechen and founding dean at Surmang Monastery (~1957–1958).

Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche (1924–2019) was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who studied at Thrangu Monastery (~1936–1958). He taught at Rumtek Monastery in 1967 and founded Karma Triyana Dharmachakra, serving as its abbot from 1978.
Khenpo Konchok Gyaltsen is a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who studied under Khunu Lama Tenzin Gyaltsen, Khyunga Rinpoche, and Pachung Rinpoche. He taught Glenn H. Mullin.
Khenpo Lodrö Dönyö is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under Bokar Rinpoche and Kalu Rinpoche, and he also taught Kalu Rinpoche.

Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang (1879–1941) was a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied under Shenphen Nangwa, Kunzang Pelden, Mipam Gyatso, and Lungtok Tenpé Nyima, among others. He taught numerous students, including Chatral Sangye Dorje.
Khenpo Sherab Püntsok studied under Ogyen Trinley Dorje and Khenchen Thrangu Rinpoche.
